## License Summary

| License | Projects | Can Embed in MIT? | Can Bundle? | Can Modify? |
|---------|----------|-------------------|-------------|-------------|
| MIT | MultiSeat-Extended, TermWrap, TermWrap Rust, ViGEmBus, HidHide, neo_multiseat | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| GPLv3 | Vibepollo, Apollo, Helios, Sunshine | No (must keep as separate process) | No | Yes (must release under GPLv3) |
| GPL-2.0 | rdpwrap | No | No | Yes (must release under GPL-2.0) |
| Custom | libvirtualhid | Unknown (license required) | Unknown | Unknown |
| Unknown | SudoVDA, Virtual-Display-Driver, parsec-vdd, rdpWrapper, LuaTools, PC-Terminalizer | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown |

---

## Key Implications for MultiSeat-Extended

### Safe to Use (MIT)
- TermWrap — Already integrated
- HidHide — Already integrated
- ViGEmBus — Legacy, being replaced by libvirtualhid
- neo_multiseat — Reference only

### Must Keep as External Process (GPLv3)
- Vibepollo — Already launched as separate process
- Apollo — Could be alternative provider
- Helios — Reference for architecture
- Sunshine — Upstream of Vibepollo

### Requires License Investigation
- SudoVDA — What are the exact terms?
- libvirtualhid — What does the custom license allow?
- Virtual-Display-Driver — What are the exact terms?

### Not Relevant
- LuaTools — Steam plugin management, not multiseat
- PC-Terminalizer — Alternative approach, not applicable
